title: The Midnight Rain
description: Victim Lord Ashford was found murdered in his gazebo at 1 AM. Suspect John claimed he was strolling in the gazebo gardens without an umbrella. The meteorological log showed continuous torrential rain from 12 AM to 2 AM. When arrested at 1:15 AM, John's jacket and shoes were completely dry. Who is lying?

explanation: John claimed to be strolling in the garden during a 2-hour torrential rain without an umbrella, yet was found completely dry minutes later.

title: The Frozen Clock
description: A collector was shot in his study. The grandfather clock was shattered by a stray bullet at 10:15 PM. Suspect Arthur has an alibi until 10:30 PM. However, forensics noted the pendulum was detached and held by a magnet placed inside before the bullet hit. What was falsified?

title: The Sealed Wine Vault
description: Baron Vance was poisoned in a locked wine vault. The wine bottle was opened in front of both the Baron and his guest Roger. Both drank from the same bottle with two identical glasses poured by Roger. Roger remained unharmed while the Baron died of cyanide. What held the poison?
